description: Source code for texture utility functions in OpenGL, including creation of simple 2D textures, cubemap textures, and mipmapped textures.

methods.name: CreateSimpleTexture2D
methods.description: Creates a 2x2 RGB texture with solid colors and sets texture parameters.

methods.name: CreateSimpleTextureCubemap
methods.description: Creates a cubemap texture with six solid color faces and sets texture parameters.

methods.name: CreateMipMappedTexture2D
methods.description: Creates a 256x256 mipmapped texture with a checkerboard pattern and sets texture parameters.
